# Calendar 1.3.1

## Bundled offline AI on every platform

- Include the verified LFM2.5 350M Q4_K_M GGUF and its upstream license in Android, Windows, Linux AppImage/Flatpak and Web/PWA packages. No separate model download or file import is required.
- Verify the pinned weights during build preparation, Android assembly, desktop packaging and before inference. Missing/corrupt weights fail the build rather than producing a model-less release.
- Precache the weights in the Web service worker for offline reload. Initial PWA installation now transfers roughly 250 MB and requires sufficient storage. Wait for offline installation to finish before disconnecting.
- Read the packaged model directly instead of creating another 229 MB IndexedDB copy. Existing imported models and calendar data remain usable. Update model setup text in English, Polish, Russian and German.

## Android language switching

- Change interface text and activity title immediately, but persist the requested launcher name and apply it only when the app goes into the background.
- Stop disabling the active launcher alias while the user is changing language. Update aliases atomically on Android 13+ and enable the replacement first on older systems.
- Keep exactly one launcher entry and preserve the selected language. Tests launch through the actual alias and check that switching all four languages keeps the WebView alive, with the icon name changing only after backgrounding.

## Permanent Android signing and migration

- Use one permanent release key and pin its public certificate fingerprint. Public CI builds require the existing repository signing secrets and verify the resulting APK certificate. A fresh debug key is no longer a release fallback.
- Keep private key material outside Git, logs and release assets. Provide setup/backup scripts and documentation for maintainers.
- **Previous 1.2.x/1.3.0 APKs used lost ephemeral debug keys and cannot be upgraded using the new key. Export calendar data from the old app before uninstalling it, migrate once, then import the backup.** Subsequent releases must retain the permanent key. Do not uninstall without a verified backup.
- The local signed APK and isolated CI compatibility APKs use different keys. Install the permanent-key distribution for future upgrades, not an ephemeral compatibility-test artifact.

## Verification

- Lint and 85 unit tests passed. Real bundled-weight browser tests passed eight English and eight Polish offline scenarios without importing weights.
- The local release APK contains the exact official GGUF and its certificate matches the pinned permanent signing identity.
- Android CI passed all required checks, including actual Polish/English model proposals, survival during foreground language selection, launcher replacement after exit and reopening with the saved language. Packaged Linux Electron also passed real bundled-model inference with HTTP blocked. Physical phones and packaged Windows/macOS inference still require separate validation.

The assistant still requires confirmation before saving calendar changes. Inference speed and available memory depend on the device. This change does not claim a guaranteed phone response time.
